index 0727dec..b2980dd 100644
--- a/src/time/window.py
+++ b/src/time/window.py
@@ -1,8 +1,10 @@
-"""Audit-created baseline bug: assumes all local billing days last 24 hours."""
+"""Audit-created correction under explicit civil-day semantics."""
 from datetime import datetime, time, timedelta, timezone
 from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
 
 
 def window_utc(day, zone):
-    start = datetime.combine(day, time.min, ZoneInfo(zone)).astimezone(timezone.utc)
-    return start, start + timedelta(hours=24)
+    tz = ZoneInfo(zone)
+    start = datetime.combine(day, time.min, tz).astimezone(timezone.utc)

+    return start, end
